description: bigville R22 / newspaper-writer Rung B (block 294000): townspeople GO TO the publisher to report what they hold, via GENERAL directed conduct + the nav flood. A Mover holding a salient Fact it has not yet reported forms a report goal aimed at whoever affords makes_known -- rep_form_report_goal sets the mover's `seeks` edge to the afforder's cell (this is literally 'go to him': the nav flood then routes there). On co-location, rep_deliver_on_arrival fires a directed delivery (the afforder `received` the Fact) -- proximity/travel-bound, exactly like every other conduct. Ablate the affordance -> no target, no goal, no delivery. Ablate movement -> never arrives, no delivery.

rules.name: rep_form_report_goal
rules.comment: A resident (Mover) holding a SALIENT, not-yet-reported Fact forms the intent to report it to whoever affords makes_known: it sets its own `seeks` edge to the afforder's current cell (the nav flood routes it there -- 'go to him' is spatial) and marks report_intent so this fires once. The target is chosen by the AFFORDANCE (find who affords making-things-known), never by a hardcoded reporter identity.

rules.name: rep_deliver_on_arrival
rules.comment: When the reporting Mover reaches the afforder's cell (both is_at the SAME cell), it delivers: the afforder `received` the Fact and the Fact is marked reported. Directed, proximity-bound conduct -- the delivery cannot happen at a distance, so it depends on the mover actually TRAVELLING there. The reporter is not the afforder (Not m==pub).
